baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative establishing verb governs the Torah, Gospel, and what was sent down, while eating names the resulting livelihood.
baseline_models.mechanism: The texts are made to stand as a maintained, straight, load-bearing order rather than merely possessed or recited. Revelation is put in its proper place, the Lord's formative care is socially enacted, and that order becomes the support through which livelihood is received.

activation_trace.role: Standing over something as its keeper supplies sustained care as the practical force of establishing the texts.
What holds a thing and a livelihood up makes establishment the community's supporting order.
Placing something in its fitting station makes received revelation material that must be properly situated in life.
Progressive repair, nurture, and completion connect the Lord to an order that forms its people over time.
An allotted edible livelihood renders eating as the material maintenance generated through that order.

changed_reading.before: Had they obeyed their scriptures, they would have been rewarded with food.
changed_reading.after: Had they made the whole received revelation stand as a maintained social order, it would have become the support through which their life and livelihood were sustained.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: What descends from their Lord is followed by eating from above them and from beneath their feet.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah lays out a vertical circuit: formative gift descends, growth and yield rise, and the standing body receives from both directions. Above and below therefore describe not two unrelated prizes but a complete ecology of nurture joining source, ground, growth, and eater.

activation_trace.role: Downward arrival supplies the upper-to-lower movement that opens the vertical circuit.
Feeding and organic growth supply the upward developmental return from what descends.
Crop and tree yield locate eating in productive growth rather than in an abstract reward alone.
Physical upper direction marks one pole of the provision field.
Physical under-position marks the groundward pole of the provision field.
The bodily foot fixes the image at the lived interface between a standing eater and the productive ground.

changed_reading.before: Provision would arrive miraculously from two spatial directions.
changed_reading.after: Upholding revelation would reconnect a full nurture circuit in which what descends from the Lord and what grows from the ground jointly sustain embodied life.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A moderate community among them is set against the many whose deliberate work is condemned.
baseline_models.mechanism: The minority is not merely statistically average. Community, orientation, straight movement, and measured action converge: it is a gathered body directed toward a purpose and keeping a viable course between excesses. The many are contrasted not by identity but by the quality of what they intentionally do.

activation_trace.role: A group held together by a common matter supplies the collective subject of the moderate course.
Purposeful direction makes the community an oriented body rather than a residual demographic.
Straightness of path and gait turns moderation into sustained right movement.
Measured balance between extremes supplies the community's operating discipline.
Numerical abundance makes the adverse side a majority without making number a criterion of truth.
The formal idiom of censure evaluates the majority's practice rather than merely labeling its members.
Purposive action locates the division in enacted conduct.

changed_reading.before: A morally middling minority is distinguished from a bad majority.
changed_reading.after: An oriented community sustains a straight, measured practice while a numerical majority is exposed by the bad work it deliberately enacts.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby sequence first depicts eating as illicit extraction that strips a community, then faults learned leaders for failing to restrain it, and finally opposes a bound hand to an extended, spending hand. Against that sequence, the focus promise becomes an economic reversal: established revelation changes appetite from devouring circulation-blocking gain into receiving and distributing sustaining provision.

activation_trace.role: Consuming and appropriating wealth gives the nearby eating its extractive economic force.
Stripping away or eradicating shows how illicit gain consumes the resource base rather than nourishing it.
Active restraint supplies the missing institutional boundary that scriptural leadership should maintain.
A binding collar supplies the image of arrested agency and blocked circulation.
Extending and releasing the hand reverses constriction into available giving.
Wealth leaving in expenditure turns the open hand into an actual circulation mechanism.

structural_cues: 5:62 and 5:63 repeat illicit eating, first as popular action and then as conduct leaders fail to restrain.
5:64 stages a direct constricted-hand versus extended-hand reversal immediately before the focus condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies extractive eating, failed restraint, constriction, extension, and expenditure; I infer that establishing revelation redirects the economic flow. A live alternative is that the focus promises bounty without specifying any human distributive mechanism.

changed_reading.after: Scriptural establishment repairs a damaged economy: predatory consumption and blocked circulation give way to open provision capable of nourishing the community.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later near-duplicate says the addressed people are not upon any substantial footing until they establish the same scriptures and received revelation. This makes the focus verb structurally literal as well as ethical: the texts must become what the community can stand on, after which livelihood from above and beneath is the consequence of restored support.

activation_trace.role: Negation of the present state clears away any claim that nominal possession already supplies footing.
A knowable, assertable thing gives the negated footing substantive rather than merely rhetorical force.
The root's support-and-livelihood image makes the establishing occurrence load-bearing even though the same occurrence record also includes the later people-group noun.
Properly stationing what was sent down explains how revelation becomes a usable foundation rather than an external object.
Formative care joins both deliveries to the same sustaining source.

structural_cues: 5:68 repeats the Torah, Gospel, received revelation, and establishing construction from 5:66.
The prepositional wording in 5:68 places the addressees upon nothing until that establishment occurs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact lexical recurrence plus negated footing; I infer a foundation-to-livelihood arrow between 5:68 and the focus. The alternative is a purely idiomatic claim of having no valid standing, without a material support image.

changed_reading.before: Establishing the texts means complying with their rules.
changed_reading.after: Establishing the texts means turning received revelation into the community's actual footing and support, without which neither its claim nor its livelihood stands.

context_deltas.mechanism: The covenant sequence shows repeated messengers meeting appetite-driven selection: the self dislikes a delivery, the receiving body splits, and one part denies while another destroys. The later ban on religious excess and following desires sharpens the focus moderate community into one that keeps the whole revelatory sequence binding instead of trimming it to preference.

activation_trace.role: A confirmed covenant supplies the binding continuity against which selective reception fails.
Successive dispatches supply a continuing sequence that must be received rather than sampled.
The self's inclination supplies the selective pressure that bends reception away from the whole.
Separated parties show appetite fragmenting the receiving community into divergent responses.
Assigning the messenger to falsehood is one concrete mode of rejecting an unwanted delivery.
Stable correspondence with reality sets the governing measure that desire and excess cannot replace.
Following behind supplies the behavioral mechanism by which alien desires become a community's course.

structural_cues: 5:70 repeats the response split as one party denies and another kills.
The branchless excess root at 5:77 word 5 is directly prohibited before desire-following and loss of the level path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covenant, successive deliveries, self-inclination, split response, truth, and prohibited excess; I infer that the focus community's moderation is fidelity to the whole against appetite-led selection. It may alternatively denote ethical balance without a specific canon-completeness claim.

changed_reading.before: The moderate community avoids behavioral extremes.
changed_reading.after: The moderate community keeps a binding, truth-measured revelatory course by refusing both religious excess and the selective rejection of whatever the self dislikes.

context_deltas.mechanism: A positive sequence later in the packet shows what establishing received revelation can look like in motion: hearing becomes understanding, recognition, confession, inscription among witnesses, hope, entry, and repaired conduct. This turns the focus from static custodianship into an uptake process that can form a new righteous collective from responsive hearers.

activation_trace.role: Hearing as understanding and compliance initiates reception beyond acoustic exposure.
Delivered revelation supplies the object that moves through the reception cascade.
Recognition through a discernible mark turns reception into identified truth.
Entering a name into a register or company converts recognition into social enrollment.
Presence joined to witnessed perception defines the company into which the hearers ask to be written.
Heartfelt hope carries recognized truth forward into a desired communal future.
Movement into an interior makes communal belonging the outcome of reception.
Repair opposed to corruption defines the practical quality of the collective sought.

structural_cues: 5:69 crosses inherited group labels with the open condition of belief and sound action.
5:83 orders hearing, visible response, recognition, confession, and requested enrollment.
5:84 asks for entry with a sound people rather than merely preservation of a prior label.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered uptake sequence and requested entry; I infer that it exemplifies how revelation is made socially operative and how a community is formed. A live alternative is that these verses describe conversion without defining the focus verb's full scope.

changed_reading.before: Existing scriptural communities are asked to maintain inherited books.
changed_reading.after: Revelation is established through a reception cascade that turns responsive hearing into recognition, witness, repaired action, and entry into an oriented community.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet first places the faithful conditional beside entry into planted gardens, then closes the positive response sequence with rivers flowing beneath those gardens as recompense. That recurrence sharpens provision from beneath the focus community's feet into a hydrological substrate: sustained flow under rooted life, with present agricultural provision capable of anticipating garden abundance.

activation_trace.role: A garden screened and enclosed by vegetation supplies the planted environment adjoining the focus condition.
Continuing provision and giving turns flow into sustained nourishment rather than static possession.
The repeated under-position directly reactivates the focus ayah's lower source of provision.
A river cutting through ground with running water gives the under-layer a concrete hydrological mechanism.
Action answered by its return marks the garden flow as a consequential counterpart to response.

structural_cues: The faithful conditional in 5:65 leads into gardens immediately before the focus conditional.
5:85 repeats the under-position in a flowing-river construction near the end of the packet's positive response arc.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent gardens and a later under-garden river flow; I infer that the focus's beneath-foot provision is hydrological and anticipatory. The alternatives are ordinary crop yield in 5:66 or a separate eschatological image in 5:85 with no intended cross-reading.

changed_reading.before: Eating from beneath their feet refers generally to produce from the soil.
changed_reading.after: The ground beneath them becomes a sustained flowing substrate of rooted abundance, a present ecological provision that can prefigure the later garden-river reward.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a prosperity promise becomes a theological marker of creatureliness. It remains anchored in the focus pairing of Lord and eating and in 5:75's explicit eating by the Messiah and his mother. Downstream prose should present it as a contextual contrast about dependence on provision, not as a replacement meaning for the focus promise.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Their Lord supplies what they eat; the eater remains an embodied recipient rather than the source of provision.

activation_trace.role: Lordship, ownership, and mastery identify the source over against the receiving eater.
Literal taking of food anchors the focus promise in embodied dependence.
The mother and nurturer branch identifies the second embodied eater in the contextual comparison.
The repeated literal eating makes bodily reception of sustenance the diagnostic action.
Food as livelihood and subsistence states the dependence carried by that eating.

changed_reading.before: The eating promise is solely a sign of prosperity.
changed_reading.after: Abundant eating also intensifies the community's proper creaturely position: richly sustained by its Lord, yet still bodily dependent on received provision.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is form-distant because it uses the packet's secondary mapping from the eating root to the branch of wholeness and enclosure. It remains visibly anchored by the same focus token and by the paired upper and lower directions around the standing body. Downstream prose must treat it as a spatial-totality resonance, never as a claim that the eating verb lexically means 'all.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The eating token is spatially completed by provision above and below the body's feet.

activation_trace.role: Wholeness through encompassing completion activates a total-field resonance around the act of eating.
The upper direction supplies the top boundary of the encompassing provision field.
The lower direction closes the field beneath the eater.
The anatomical foot centers the encompassing field on an embodied, grounded community.
The recurring whole-or-every-time branch nearby reinforces total recurrence without redefining the focus verb.

changed_reading.after: The two directions spatially complete one nutritive habitat: the established community stands inside an environment that has become sustaining all around it.

strongest_changes: Eating changes from a generic reward into the repaired opposite of illicit extraction and blocked circulation.
The exact recurrence in 5:68 makes establishing revelation the acquisition of communal footing and support.
The moderate community becomes a purpose-directed body that resists appetite-led selection and religious excess.
The positive arc in 5:83-85 renders establishment as responsive uptake and gives beneath-foot provision a flowing garden ecology.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah joins textual establishment, vertical ecology, economic circulation, and community formation in one conditional mechanism; the surrounding packet repeatedly tests each link through failed and successful modes of reception.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal direction from scriptural establishment to distributive repair is inferred rather than grammatically stated.
Beneath-foot provision may be ordinary agricultural yield, garden foreshadowing, or both.
The whole-habitat outlier depends on a deliberately contained secondary root mapping and should remain exploratory.
The moderate community's nonselective fidelity may be narrower than its broader ethical balance.
